panel_description_zh: 全景俯视，客厅一角，架在三脚架上的小型摄像机，镜头朝向客卧门口，镜头有微弱反光，反光里隐约映出房间局部；地面有折叠灰毯、空烟灰缸、未开封可乐罐；门缝透出一线冷白晨光；整个画面几乎接近黑白。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: MC 鲁迅
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 这是一个离异老哥提供的自制视频。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. High-angle overhead establishing shot of a small consumer camcorder mounted on a tripod in the corner of a modest Chinese apartment living room. The camera lens faces a closed guest-bedroom door in the lower-right of the frame. A faint reflection glints on the camera lens, the reflection hinting at the room's interior without showing clear detail. On the floor beside the tripod sit a folded grey blanket, an empty glass ashtray, and an unopened red-and-white soda can. The guest-bedroom door seam leaks a thin blade of cold white morning light. The rest of the room is dim and near-monochrome cool blue-grey. Near-black overall, only two faint light sources. Documentary surveillance mood. Text watermark 'P01-PN01' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: people in frame, anime proportions, exaggerated lighting, daylight interior, bright living room, decorative plants, family photos on walls, any readable brand logos on the camcorder
